title: Ochre: Steppe Flyover
author: WhatHasKHANGotToSay
selftext:
GitHub: [https://github.com/rornic/ochre](https://github.com/rornic/ochre)

Engine: Bevy

Code: foundations hand-written by me over 5 years, but lately using Claude Code has massively accelerated output. 

Music: generated using Suno. 

Art: Stable Diffusion in ComfyUI, all done headless in Claude Code using a block textures skill.

Specs: Recorded on RTX 2060, Ryzen 7 9800X3D. Render distances only possible on this GPU because of intense performance optimisation -- skill for that in the repo too.

Anyone getting good results using Claude Code for 3D modelling? Finding it really struggles with organic things (e.g. a bear).
